delay.description: Queues the commands after the semicolon to run after the requested number of milliseconds without pausing unrelated command-buffer work.
delay.summary: Run following commands after a millisecond delay.

delaycancel.description: Cancels pending millisecond-based delay entries whose command text contains the supplied text. An empty string matches every pending delay.

ifcvar.description: Tests a cvar against conditions in order and executes the command belonging to the first match. Conditions support literal string equality; numeric $=, $!=, $>, $<, $>= and $<= comparisons; $contains; $beginswith/$startswith; $endswith; $else; and values read from another cvar with a leading $. The argument count includes the command itself.
ifcvar.summary: Execute a command selected by comparisons against a cvar.

mnext.description: Simulates the operating system next-track media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mnext.summary: Send the next-track media key on Windows.

mpause.description: Simulates the operating system play/pause media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mpause.summary: Send the play/pause media key on Windows.

mprev.description: Simulates the operating system previous-track media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mprev.summary: Send the previous-track media key on Windows.

mstop.description: Simulates the operating system stop-media key. Registered only in Windows builds.
mstop.summary: Send the stop-media key on Windows.

strsub.description: Executes a command after replacing text surrounded by dollar signs with the value of that cvar. A doubled dollar sign emits one literal dollar sign.
strsub.summary: Execute a command with $cvar$ value substitution.

waitf.description: Queues the commands after the semicolon to run after the requested number of rendered frames without pausing unrelated command-buffer work.
waitf.summary: Run following commands after a frame-count delay.

waitfcancel.description: Cancels pending frame-based waitf entries whose command text contains the supplied text. An empty string matches every pending waitf.

cg_camerafps.description: Sets the emulated frame rate used to make third-person camera damping frame-rate independent. Values below 15 select the original JK2/JKA multiplayer damping path; values of 15 or more use the time-adjusted path, with the original response reproduced when the actual frame rate matches this value.
cg_camerafps.summary: Set the reference frame rate for third-person camera damping.

values.meaning: Use the original frame-rate-dependent JK2/JKA multiplayer camera damping.
Use frame-rate-independent damping based on this emulated frame rate.

sv_httpdownloads.description: Enables fast HTTP downloads for referenced PK3 files. When enabled, the server advertises either its built-in HTTP endpoint or the external URL configured by sv_httpServerPort to supporting clients.
sv_httpdownloads.summary: Enable the server's JK2MV-derived HTTP auto-download path.

values.meaning: Disable HTTP auto-download advertising and stop the built-in HTTP server.
Advertise HTTP downloads and start or redirect the HTTP endpoint.

sv_httpserverport.description: Configures the HTTP auto-download endpoint. A numeric value selects the built-in web server's port; a value beginning with http:// advertises that external base URL instead.
sv_httpserverport.summary: Set the built-in HTTP download port or an external HTTP URL.

cl_downloadprotocol.description: Reports the protocol selected for the active file download. The client sets this internal cvar to HTTP when the server advertised an HTTP endpoint and otherwise sets it to UDP.
cl_downloadprotocol.summary: Report whether the active download uses HTTP or UDP.

values.meaning: Download from the server's advertised HTTP endpoint.
Use the legacy in-protocol UDP download path.

r_dynamicglowbloom.description: Controls the rend2 dynamic-glow bloom strength. Zero skips the bloom pass; positive values up to the enforced maximum of 2 are passed to the high-pass shader as bloom strength.
r_dynamicglowbloom.summary: Set rend2 dynamic-glow bloom strength from 0 through 2.

values.meaning: Disable the dynamic-glow bloom pass.
Use this positive value, up to 2, as the shader's bloom strength.

cg_drawcrosshairnames.description: Controls target-name display below the crosshair. Zero disables it, negative values display a name only while the crosshair remains on the target, and positive values are the fade duration in seconds.
cg_drawcrosshairnames.summary: Set crosshair target-name display and fade duration.

values.meaning: Do not draw target names.
Draw only while the crosshair is currently on the target; do not fade afterward.
Fade for this many seconds.

cg_drawcrosshairnamescolours.description: Selects crosshair-name coloring. Zero strips player color codes and uses green for allies and red for enemies; one preserves name color codes and starts from white.
cg_drawcrosshairnamescolours.summary: Choose team-aware or player-name crosshair colors.

values.meaning: Use green/red ally/enemy colors and sanitize name color codes.
Preserve color codes in player names.

cg_drawcrosshairnamesopacity.description: Multiplies the target-name fade alpha by this opacity. Runtime use clamps the effective value to the inclusive range 0 through 1.
cg_drawcrosshairnamesopacity.summary: Set crosshair target-name opacity from 0 to 1.

cg_movementkeys.description: Selects the movement-input overlay style, including classic, attack-aware, and movable crosshair layouts.
cg_movementkeys.summary: Select the on-screen movement-key overlay style.

r_drawfog.description: Controls fog rendering. The Vulkan registration documents 0 as disabled, 1 as software fog, and 2 as hardware fog; the same cvar is registered by vanilla, rend2, Vulkan, and the dedicated renderer stub.
r_drawfog.summary: Select disabled, software, or hardware fog rendering.

values.meaning: Disable fog.
Use software fog.
Use hardware fog.

ui_isjapro.description: Menu-only state the UI keeps while reading server info. `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` clears it on every refresh and sets it to 1 when the connected server's `gamename` begins with `japro`, so menu files can show or hide jaPRO-specific pages.
ui_isjapro.summary: Report whether the connected server identifies as jaPRO.

ui_racemode.description: Menu-only state the UI keeps while reading server info. `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` clears it on every refresh and sets it to 1 when a jaPRO server advertises `JAPRO_CINFO2_RACEMODE` in its `jcinfo2` key. A value set by hand is replaced at the next refresh.
ui_racemode.summary: Report whether the connected jaPRO server runs race mode.

values.meaning: The server does not advertise race mode, or its info has not been read yet.
The connected jaPRO server advertises race mode.

ui_tribesmode.description: Menu-only state the UI keeps while reading server info. `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` clears it on every refresh and sets it to 1 when a jaPRO server advertises `JAPRO_CINFO2_WTTRIBES` in its `jcinfo2` key; the in-game tribes menu reads it to offer the class and pack pages. A value set by hand is replaced at the next refresh.
ui_tribesmode.summary: Report whether the connected jaPRO server runs tribes mode.

values.meaning: The server does not advertise tribes mode, or its info has not been read yet.
The connected jaPRO server advertises tribes mode.

ui_allowregistration.description: Menu-only state the UI keeps while reading server info. `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` clears it on every refresh and sets it to 1 when a jaPRO server advertises `JAPRO_CINFO2_REGISTRATION` in its `jcinfo2` key, which is what offers account registration in the menus.
ui_allowregistration.summary: Report whether the connected jaPRO server accepts account registration.

values.meaning: The server does not advertise account registration, or its info has not been read yet.
The connected jaPRO server accepts account registration.

ui_allowsaberswitch.description: Menu-only state the UI keeps while reading server info. `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` clears it on every refresh, then sets it to 1 for a JA+, UAGalaxy or AbyssMod server, and for a jaPRO server below the team gametypes that advertises `JAPRO_CINFO2_SABERSWITCH`.
ui_allowsaberswitch.summary: Report whether the connected server offers the saber-switch command.

ui_sv_pure.description: Menu-only mirror of the connected server's `sv_pure` systeminfo value, refreshed by `UI_UpdateCurrentServerInfo` and rewritten only when it changes so the cvar update function runs on the following frame.
ui_sv_pure.summary: Mirror the connected server's pure-server setting for the menus.

g_neutralflag.description: Selects a neutral-flag game mode. Values 1 to 3 are rabbit variants for FFA and team FFA; values 4 to 6 are one-flag CTF variants for the CTF gametype, and a value outside a gametype's range leaves that gametype's normal flags in place. Changing the value swaps the flags immediately through `CVU_Rabbit`, without a map restart. Every mode needs a map with a `team_CTF_neutralflag`, and the one-flag modes also need `trigger_multiple` capture zones: spawnflag 16384 for values 4 and 5, spawnflag 32768 for value 6. The stock maps have neither. `g_neutralFlagTimer` sets how long a capture takes.
g_neutralflag.summary: Choose a rabbit or one-flag CTF mode built around a neutral flag.

values.meaning: Off. The map's neutral flag is removed at load, and CTF keeps its red and blue flags.
Rabbit, in FFA and team FFA: a neutral flag spawns and players fight to carry it.
Sniper rabbit: as 1, but picking up the flag leaves the carrier with only a disruptor and 300 ammo.
Rabbit where the carrier scores a point for every five seconds they hold the flag.
One-flag CTF: score by holding the neutral flag inside your own team's capture zone for `g_neutralFlagTimer`.
One-flag CTF: score by holding the neutral flag inside the other team's capture zone for `g_neutralFlagTimer`.

One-flag CTF with capture points: bringing the neutral flag into a team's capture point puts that team's flag at its base, and the team scores when `g_neutralFlagTimer` runs out unless the other team takes that flag first.

g_neutralflagtimer.description: Milliseconds a capture takes in the one-flag CTF modes of `g_neutralFlag`. In modes 4 and 5 the carrying team's progress rises while it holds the flag in a capture zone and falls while it does not; in mode 6 it counts from the moment a team's flag is placed at its base. `OneFlagCTFCheckTimers` updates the progress every 250 milliseconds and prints a countdown to every player. A negative value is treated as 0 for that countdown. The rabbit modes do not use it.
g_neutralflagtimer.summary: Set how long a one-flag CTF capture takes, in milliseconds.

restricts.description: Bitmask of client-side restrictions a jaPRO server advertises in its server info. The game module only registers it as a server-info cvar; TaystJK and jaPRO clients read the `restricts` key when they parse server info and enforce the bits themselves, so a client that ignores the key is not restricted. Add the values of the bits you want. Bits 1, 3 and 5 are defined in the client but never read, so they have no effect, and the yaw-speed, third-person-angle and strafe-bot bits apply only while racing.
restricts.summary: Advertise client-side restrictions that TaystJK and jaPRO clients enforce.

values.meaning: Disable the client-side strafe bot in race mode.
No effect: defined but never read.
Hide the lead indicator.
No effect: defined but never read.
Force `cl_yawspeed` to 0 while racing on a jaPRO server.
No effect: defined but never read.
Hide player name labels.
Disable the `flipkick` command.
Hide other players' strafe trails.
Disable `/do`, and make `lowjump` and the `+duck` no-roll bind fall back to `wait`-based sequences instead of the client's timed follow-up.
Reset `cg_thirdPersonAngle` to 0 while moving in a race on a jaPRO server.
